key_insight: RedSage transforms a general LLM into a cybersecurity generalist by continual pretraining on a large, curated 11.8B-token (28.6K-document) cybersecurity corpus—delivering domain expertise while avoiding reliance on proprietary APIs.
problem_solved: Addresses the gap between privacy-risky proprietary API assistants and open models that lack cybersecurity-specific adaptation, enabling a privacy-conscious LLM tailored to diverse security workflows.
method: Curate a focused cybersecurity corpus (11.8B tokens, 28.6K documents) via large-scale web filtering plus manual collection spanning frameworks, offensive techniques, and tools.
Perform continual pretraining of a base LLM on this cybersecurity dataset to inject domain knowledge and improve task relevance.
Design for privacy-preserving deployment (reducing dependence on external proprietary APIs) and evaluate on security-relevant tasks/workflows.
impact: Enables AI/ML and security teams to use a domain-adapted LLM that improves performance on cyber tasks while supporting privacy-conscious deployment—speeding incident response, tooling integration, and secure automation.
